description: Every declared deploy release of the estate: the ordered acts that take a change's component digests from merged to serving-and-verified. A release lands WITH the change it covers (it is declared at t=0, before merge) and its acts move through the dev-plane ledger, one governed decision per transition, written by `node scripts/govern/devplane-pep.mjs release <release-id> admit|record|verify|refuse|rollback <act>`. An act's state is read from those ledger rows, never stored here.
provenance: source: the example IS the first real release of the registry (the release lifecycle change-set), copied so the example slot is not synthetic.

default_scope.rule: A merged change that introduces no prerequisite delta (no new secret row, service binding, D1 migration, internal-only Worker, retired secret or removed hostname — the deltas scripts/govern/_deploy-release.mjs releaseDeltas() reads from the range) belongs to no release and deploys on its promotion rows alone.

releases.title: The release lifecycle itself: contract, release factor, door and governed act operations, with no production behaviour change

verification.proves: The full test chain of ci.yml is green on main's squash of this change-set: the release factor, the door and the deploy-release-canonical gate run on the landed tree and admit every deploy exactly as before (this release gates no component).
